unit.explanation: Headline refers to 22 patients tested with FOLFOX + bevacizumab.

readout.explanation: Based on relative vessel density and relative tumoroid diameter compared to control.

direction.explanation: Match defined by consistency between chip response and clinical outcome; sensitivity and specificity both reported.

threshold_rule.explanation: Youden index and bootstrap sampling used to determine optimal cutoff values for vessel density (48.97%) and tumoroid diameter (50.47%).

threshold_timing.explanation: Cutoff determined on the same 22 patients being evaluated.

patient_mapping.explanation: Patient IDs (P01-P43 subset) available in Table S1.

regimen_match.explanation: FOLFOX + bevacizumab tested in both chip and clinical setting.

n_units.explanation: 22 patients included in the validation cohort.

split.explanation: Threshold optimized on the same cohort used for evaluation.

headline.blocked_reason: Individual patient-level chip predictions (sensitive/resistant) and clinical truths (CR/PR vs SD/PD) for all 22 patients not found in accessible source tables. Source data files (Source data figure 5.xlsx sheets 5n, 5o) contain raw vessel density and tumoroid diameter measurements per patient but not the binary classifications or clinical outcomes needed to reconstruct the accuracy calculation. The aggregate accuracy of 86.36% (19/22) is reported only in the article text.

notes: Accuracy 86.36% corresponds to 19 correct predictions out of 22 patients.
Sensitivity 81.82% and specificity 90.91% also reported in text.
Figure 5P (gr5.jpg) shows heatmap with individual patient results but exact per-patient values cannot be extracted from image alone.
Source data contains raw continuous measurements but not the dichotomized predictions or clinical truth labels required for row-level reconstruction.
